# The elements

The cross-cutting properties of physical AI. A system is built from components
(perception, cognition, action, memory, learning), but it is judged by these.
Every component chapter is read through them, and
[placement](07-placement-and-systems.qmd) is the act of trading them against one
another.

| Element | What it means | Where it bites hardest | How you measure it |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Timeliness** | the world has deadlines; late is wrong | control, perception | end-to-end latency, deadline misses |
| **Reliability** | runs unattended; failure is physical | action, deployment | time between failures, recovery time |
| **Safety** | actions can harm; fail-safe is mandatory | action | bounded motion, time to safe stop |
| **Memory and state** | persists and accumulates; not stateless | memory, learning | recall accuracy, state growth |
| **Energy and thermal** | embodied means power-bound | perception, on-device models | milliwatts, joules per task, temperature |
| **Privacy and trust** | senses private spaces | sensing, data, deployment | data egress, on-device retention |
| **Robustness** | the open world is out of distribution | perception, cognition | degradation under shift, failure modes |
| **Adaptivity** | improves from its own experience | learning | data yield, improvement per cycle |
| **Observability** | you can explain what it did and why | cognition, deployment | traceability of a decision |

## Reading the table

No system maximizes all of these; you choose. A reflex on the device buys
timeliness and privacy and spends capability. A cloud call buys capability and
spends timeliness and privacy. The chapters that follow each pick up two or three
of these elements and show the trade in a real component.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Teaching note"}

- **Hook**: hand students the empty table and the robot; have them fill in "how
  you measure it" from their own build before reading the chapters.
- **Open question**: nine elements may be too many to meet at once. Which three
  are the irreducible core for a first pass? Candidates: timeliness, safety,
  privacy.

:::
